messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-05-29, the Ember team's pager contact is Oskar, not Diego. [constraint; valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team's pager contact is Diego, not Oskar, for this cycle. [constraint; valid 2026-04-13 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-02, the Ember team reminded everyone to page Oskar, not Diego, for anything this cycle. [constraint; valid 2026-03-02 to 2026-04-13; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-02]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar has the Ember pager for the cycle, taking over from Diego. [decision; valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-13, Diego has the Ember pager for the cycle, taking over from Oskar. [decision; valid 2026-04-13 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is on the Ember team on-call rotation as the primary on-call. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Oskar is off the Ember team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is the primary on-call for the Ember team, taking over from Diego. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Diego is the primary on-call for the Ember team. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- As of 2026-05-29, Diego is off the Ember team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
- On 2026-05-28 the Ember team noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-28]
- On 2026-04-14 the Dune team noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-2]
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- On 2026-03-11 the Cinder team noticed that the billing API's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11-2]
- Oskar wrote up the handover doc for the feature-flags service handover to the Atlas team for Farah. [valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
    earlier: Oskar wrote up the handover doc for the feature-flags service handover to the Dune team for Farah. [valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
- The feature-flags service was owned by the Ember team as of 2025-11-06, having moved from the Atlas team, until ownership transferred to the Atlas team on 2026-02-11. [decision; valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
    earlier: The feature-flags service was owned by the Ember team as of 2025-11-06, having moved from the Atlas team, until ownership transferred to the Dune team on 2026-02-11. [decision; valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-06, the feature-flags service is owned by the Ember team, having moved from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2025-11-06 to 2026-02-11; recorded by handover/2025-11-06-feature-flags]
- The feature-flags service was owned by the Ember team from 2025-11-06, having moved from the Atlas team, until ownership transferred to the Atlas team on 2026-02-11. [valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
    earlier: The feature-flags service was owned by the Ember team from 2025-11-06, having moved from the Atlas team, until ownership transferred to the Dune team on 2026-02-11. [valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
    earlier: The feature-flags service is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-11-06, having moved from the Atlas team. [valid 2025-11-06 to 2026-02-11; recorded by handover/2025-11-06-feature-flags]
    earlier: The feature-flags service is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-06; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- As of 2026-02-11, the feature-flags service is owned by the Atlas team, having moved from the Ember team; the Dune team never owned it. [decision; valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
    earlier: As of 2026-02-11, the feature-flags service is owned by the Dune team, having moved from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
